details:
Seeing the recent talk about the disallowing of mod, I would actually really like to see more official QoL with the friends list and notification system. 
Currently many people including myself use applications like VRCX, which to my knowledge, is not a client, but instead reads the websites API which anyone can look at by using the web developer tools and looking into it on the official website. 
VRCX is just making it a good GUI to read that API, which at the current moment is not officially public, but there has been community documentation on it. I would like to see VRChat officially support a healthy API support.
VRCX to my own use and knowledge, doesn't have any malicious intent but instead just a massive quality of life. Many user have VRCX opened up on their XSOverlay or similar overlay applications to see the lists and notifications that they want. Additionally, it is a luxury to have VRCX open while not in the game or in VR to help check to see if anyone is online if you don't feel like getting on alone.
Creating public and official documentation will help many users create a better relationship VRChat when working with 3-party applications or projects that could still improve each users experience. Even with this official support, not every user will even use it keeping the base game simply the same.
title: Create official documentation of the web API
